_comment: Taught words retired under the child-safe content policy (docs/CHILD_SAFE_CONTENT_POLICY.md).
A tombstone, not a deletion: the id stays in word-ids.json and a learner's progress, saved words,
review schedule and mistakes rows for it are kept on the device. The runtime reads this file to
drop a retired word from today's plan and the review queue without erasing what was earned.
`replacement` names the word that fills the same slot when one exists; null means the level band
had supply and nothing was authored in its place.
